{"text": "The function `collect_dataclass_fields` is a utility within the Pydantic library for gathering and processing field information from Python dataclasses.", "type": "intent"},
{"text": "The function `collect_dataclass_fields` takes a dataclass type `cls` as its primary input.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `collect_dataclass_fields` accepts optional parameters `ns_resolver`, `typevars_map`, and `config_wrapper`.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `collect_dataclass_fields` iterates over the class hierarchy of the provided dataclass and collects fields defined within each base class.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `collect_dataclass_fields` evaluates field types using a namespace resolver to handle complex annotations.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `collect_dataclass_fields` skips fields marked as `ClassVar`.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `collect_dataclass_fields` skips fields that have no initializer and no default value.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "When a field's default value is a Pydantic `FieldInfo` instance, the function `collect_dataclass_fields` checks compatibility between initialization flags.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `collect_dataclass_fields` raises a `PydanticUserError` when the initialization flags of a `FieldInfo` default conflict.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `collect_dataclass_fields` applies type variable mappings to the collected fields.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `collect_dataclass_fields` updates the collected fields from docstrings using the provided configuration wrapper.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `collect_dataclass_fields` returns a dictionary mapping field names to their corresponding `FieldInfo` objects.", "type": "dataflow"}
